project_info.theme: Scientific absorption-spectrum comparison for pongamia seed extract components
project_info.color_palette: Soft Pink, Light Peach, Pale Blue, Cyan, Magenta, Black

main_subject.detail: A pastel scientific infographic showing the absorption spectrum of neem-like seed extract components, with a chart comparing Karanjin and Pongamol against a dotted Avobenzone curve across 280 to 400 nm.
main_subject.style: Clean skincare science graphic, pastel educational data visualization, modern lab-style infographic

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'PHỔ HẤP THU CỦA CHIẾT XUẤT HẠT ĐẬU DẦU', chart labels 'KARANJIN', 'PONGAMOL', 'AVOBENZONE', axis labels 'ĐỘ HẤP THU' and 'BƯỚC SÓNG (nm)', and the caption 'Chiết xuất hạt đậu dầu chứa đồng thời Karanjin và Pongamol được chứng minh có khả năng hấp thụ tia UV tương tự màng lọc hóa học Avobenzone.'.
items: Top Left: Large black headline spanning the pastel background.
Top Right: Open negative space above the graph, preserving the airy educational layout.
Bottom Left: Black y-axis labeled 'ĐỘ HẤP THU' and the x-axis beginning at 280 nm.
Bottom Right: End of x-axis at 400 nm with label 'BƯỚC SÓNG (nm)'.
Center/Background: A filled magenta Karanjin curve at lower wavelengths, a filled cyan Pongamol curve peaking around mid-range, and a dotted black Avobenzone comparison curve across the graph.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp chart readability, soft pastel gradient wash, clean scientific presentation
